spectrogram.reference: 20 log10(abs(STFT) / sum(Hann window)); common absolute -80 to 0 dB scale; no per-clip normalization.

rms_matched.method: Match whole-clip RMS within each example to its damaged-input reference level, then apply one shared safety gain across its tracks.
rms_matched.spectrograms: Rendered from the selected playback audio, using the original absolute dB scale.
rms_matched.note: Playback gain only; inference and original audio remain unchanged. Equal RMS is not equal perceived loudness or a quality score.
